cohort: 55 women at high risk of second trimester miscarriage and extreme preterm delivery due to cervical insufficiency who underwent pre-conception LCC between January 2017 - December 2021 and had at least one previous unsuccessful transvaginal cervical cerclage.
finding: In women with previous unsuccessful transvaginal cervical cerclage, preconception LCC resulted in a 100% live-birth rate and neonatal survival rate among pregnancies progressing beyond the first trimester.
followup_time: Until December 2022 (variable based on time of surgery)
